editorial:
Imagine trying to navigate a messy love triangle while the world is falling apart and zombies are wandering the streets. You follow a group of friends who are already stressed out by money problems and high expectations from their families. The vibe is a strange mix of a sad drama and a scary horror flick. It does not just focus on the gore, but instead looks at how people deal with loss and heartbreak when they have no jobs and nowhere to go. You will feel the tension as the characters argue about their futures while trying not to get eaten.

The acting feels very real, making you care about whether these people survive or not. While the story starts a bit slow, the emotional payoffs are worth the wait. One downside is that some of the effects look a bit cheap, but that actually adds to the indie charm of the film. If you like stories that make you think about life and love during a crisis, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a heartbreaking choice. As the zombie outbreak gets worse, the main characters realize they cannot all survive together. The love triangle reaches a breaking point where one person has to sacrifice themselves so the others can find safety. It ends on a sad note, showing that even in a world full of monsters, the pain of losing someone you love is the hardest thing to deal with.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romance mixed with zombie survival stories.
